decisions.rationale: anthropic SDK 1.2.0 messages.create has no temperature param and claude-sonnet-5 rejects sampling params; determinism comes from baseline diffing + thresholds
claude-sonnet-5 uses adaptive thinking by default; thinking tokens count against max_tokens and would truncate JSON

decisions.decision: --fake = clean deterministic oracle against baseline_fake.json; --demo-noise adds a %17 mis-categoriser so `make demo` renders a CRITICAL regression; real runs use baseline.json
decisions.rationale: CI smoke run and demo cannot share one fake baseline

decisions.decision: Provider-errored cases are excluded from pass-rate denominators, group deltas, adversarial_failures and flips; >5% provider errors → PROVIDER_UNSTABLE (reported, never stored)
decisions.rationale: A transient 5xx must not read as a model regression / merge block
No run-history persistence in CI; documented in README

decisions.decision: Golden fixtures are pre-extracted text, not PDFs
decisions.rationale: Extract layer lands in the next plan; isolates the LLM step
